items.title: Vi Redd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: Tomorrow I may attend O.C.’s church, O.C. Smith? He has a Religious Science church, and I have a friend here from Chicago and she wanted to see his new edifice. So I may go there tomorrow.

ctx.x: Well the church is a big part of your life, isn’t it?

Yes it is. If it wasn’t, I don’t think I’d be here to talk about it. Yeah my church is important. I’m a member of Faith United Methodist Church. But I tell everybody I’m very ecumenical. I’m not hung up on people’s denominations. Tomorrow I may attend O.C.’s church, O.C. Smith? He has a Religious Science church, and I have a friend here from Chicago and she wanted to see his new edifice. So I may go there tomorrow.
